description: This file defines a Keystone 6 schema for a User list, including access controls, UI configurations, and fields such as name, password, and isAdmin, with session-based permission functions.

methods.name: isAdminOrSameUser
methods.description: Determines if the session user is an admin or the same user as the item.

methods.name: isAdminOrSameUserFilter
methods.description: Returns a filter object for admin or the current user.

methods.name: isAdmin
methods.description: Checks if the session user has admin privileges.
